text:
priya: FYI spotted a weird auth flow in audit logs — a delegated dev role token was used to call the Dedicated control plane from a non-allowlisted IP. Can we triage?

matt: which tenant / logs?

priya: paste log lines:

```
[2026-03-19T22:11:03Z] token_exchange svc=token-svc user=svc-dev-delegate actor=infra-ci ip=203.0.113.45 resource=dedicated-api tenant=acme action=GetModel
audit_id=evt_0x9a3b2c
```

li: that IP (203.0.113.45) is not in acme's VPC allowlist. how did token-svc succeed on exchange? was there a wildcard tenant check?

julian: we rolled a change last week to support cross-tenant delegation for internal infra services. possible bug: token-svc only checked caller principal, not target tenant allowlist.

priya: also saw KMS activity correlated to the same time:

```
KMS: Decrypt request key=projects/redwood/keys/dedicated/tenant-acme principal=svc-token-exchanger time=2026-03-19T22:10:59Z request_id=req_kms_77
```

matt: if token-svc can call KMS Decrypt on tenant keys and then mint tokens, that's the root. we should scope KMS access tighter.

li: immediate action: block token-svc from KMS decrypt on tenant-acme keys. matt can you roll deny?

matt: on it. patching IAM to remove roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on serviceAccount:svc-token-exchanger@redwood. ETA 15m.

priya: can we confirm whether data was read or just attempted? any dedicated-api logs for GetModel responses?

sec-bot: alert: dedicated-api GET /v1/models returned 200 tenant=acme request_id=req_94f bytes_out=2.1MB count=3

julian: looks like 3 model fetches in a short window. likely exfil. mark as incident.

priya: agreed. open incident, notify compliance and rotate keys.

matt: INC-2026-56 created and assigned to @matt, @priya. starting rotation of tenant acme KMS keys and revoking issued delegated tokens.

li: after rotation, how do we safely re-enable delegation for infra flows? suggestion: update token-svc to enforce target-tenant VPC allowlist check before issuing delegated tokens, and require caller to originate from allowlisted subnet or use mTLS with client cert validation.

julian: also add an audit flag field: "token_via_delegation": true for those exchanges so we can filter quickly. add unit/integration tests to role binding templates to prevent wildcard decrypt bindings in future PRs.

matt: plan: helm patch to token-svc adding the allowlist enforcement and feature flag TOKEN_DELEGATION_CHECK=true. will canary deploy and provide emergency kill switch TOKEN_DELEGATION_ENABLED=false. ETA: canary in ~2h, full rollout once green.

priya: notify affected customer acme, escalate to legal if required. collect export of all audit events for the window 2026-03-19T21:50Z — 2026-03-19T22:30Z.

matt: export started, will attach to INC ticket. revoke tokens and rotate KMS key completed at 2026-03-19T22:28Z.

priya: postmortem owners: priya, julian, matt. follow-ups captured in INC-2026-56.

li: follow-up list I suggest: 1) tighten KMS IAM templates (no wildcards), 2) token-svc allowlist + tests, 3) add delegation audit flag and dashboard, 4) run org-wide infra PR review for recent role refactors.

priya: thanks. tagging :eyes: and :lock:. will update once customer notified.
